tha-ap33:1.1: [IV. KUṆḌADHĀNAVAGGO.] [31. Kuṇḍadhāna.] Sattāhaṃ patisallīnaṃ sayambhuṃ aggapuggalaṃ / pasannacitto sumano Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃ. // //
tha-ap33:2.1: Vuṭṭhitaṃ kālam aññāya Padumuttaramahāmuṇiṃ / mahantaṃ kadalīkaṇṇiṃ gahetvā upagañch' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap33:3.1: Paṭiggahetvā bhagavā taṃ phalaṃ lokanāyako / mama cittaṃ pasādento paribhuñji mahāmuṇi. // //
tha-ap33:4.1: Paribhuñjitvā sambuddho satthavāho anuttaro / sakāsane nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha: // //
tha-ap33:5.1: Ye vasanti sametāro yakkhā imamhi pabbate / araññe bhūtabhavyāni sunantu vacanaṃ mama. // //
tha-ap33:6.1: Yo so buddhaṃ upaṭṭhāsi migarājā va kesarī / tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato: // // ‘So' yam
tha-ap33:7.1: ekādasakkhattuṃ devarājā bhavissati / catuttiṃsatikkhattuṃ ca cakkavattī bhavissati. // //
tha-ap33:8.1: Kappasatasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo / Gotamo nāma gottena satthā loke bhavissati. // //
tha-ap33:9.1: Akkositvāna samaṇe sīlavante anāsave / pāpakammavipākena nāmadheyyaṃ labhissati. // //
tha-ap33:10.1: Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito / Koṇḍadhāno ti nāmena sāvako so bhavissati.' // //
tha-ap33:11.1: Pavivekam anuyutto jhāyī jhānarato ahaṃ / tosayitvāna satthāraṃ viharāmi anāsavo. // //
tha-ap33:12.1: Sāvakaggehi parivuto bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhato / bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā salākaṃ gāhayī jino. // //
tha-ap33:13.1: Ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā vanditvā lokanāyakaṃ / vadataṃ varassa purato paṭhamaṃ aggahes' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap33:14.1: Tena kammena bhagavā dasasahassīpakampako / bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā agge ṭhāne ṭhapesi maṃ. // //
tha-ap33:15.1: Viriyaṃ me dhuradhorayhaṃ yogakkhemādhivāhanaṃ / dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ sammāsambuddhasāsane. // //
tha-ap33:16.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap33:17.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Kuṇḍadhāno thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
